findings.message: EOL extension to 2027-04-16 exceeds the 3-month cap (today + 3 months = 2027-01-16). An accepted support plan must be recorded in CODEOWNERS before this extension can be approved.

PPA declaration added (canonical-demo/stable) without rationale or package impact documentation. Prior revision sourced from Ubuntu archive; proposed revision introduces PPA. No apt candidate/origin report supplied to verify package selection changes.

summary: Commit 0000...0002 → 0000...0003; end-of-life 2026-12-01 → 2027-04-16; PPA canonical-demo/stable added. EOL extension lacks required support plan approval.
